facts.definition: The placement of one symbol unit of a component instance on a schematic sheet. It has its own position and orientation while referring to the component's electrical terminal identities.

title: Symbol unit
summary: An independently placeable portion of a component's schematic representation, such as transistor A or an amplifier's power unit. All units of one component instance share its physical implementation and purchasing identity.

facts.definition: An independently placeable portion of a component's schematic representation, such as transistor A or an amplifier's power unit. All units of one component instance share its physical implementation and purchasing identity.

title: Tag
summary: A free label on a lineage, kept like a shelf in the owning source's label map. Many tags may apply; none is identity.

facts.definition: A free label on a lineage, kept like a shelf in the owning source's label map. Many tags may apply; none is identity.

title: Terminal class
summary: How a component definition classifies a terminal: electrical, with one or more pin functions; device NC, declared by the device as not connected; or reserved. Device-NC and reserved terminals have no functions, cannot be wired and need no project decision.

facts.definition: How a component definition classifies a terminal: electrical, with one or more pin functions; device NC, declared by the device as not connected; or reserved. Device-NC and reserved terminals have no functions, cannot be wired and need no project decision.

title: Tie
summary: An intentional join between two to eight distinct nets at a stated place. One component may contain several independent ties. Each has its own terminals, copper bridges and purpose. A copper tie is always closed. A solder jumper or 0 Ω link follows the component’s population in the active assembly variant.

facts.definition: An intentional join between two to eight distinct nets at a stated place. One component may contain several independent ties. Each has its own terminals, copper bridges and purpose. A copper tie is always closed. A solder jumper or 0 Ω link follows the component’s population in the active assembly variant.

title: Title block
summary: The block in a page frame's corner that shows the project properties (title, revision, date, author, company), the sheet's name and "sheet n of m".

facts.definition: The block in a page frame's corner that shows the project properties (title, revision, date, author, company), the sheet's name and "sheet n of m".

title: Unavailable function
summary: A pin function that a particular device binding cannot provide. An instance whose active function is unavailable in a binding cannot use that binding.

facts.definition: A pin function that a particular device binding cannot provide. An instance whose active function is unavailable in a binding cannot use that binding.

title: Unit set
summary: A dimension with its linear units, each with a symbol, aliases, a scale to SI and whether it accepts SI prefixes. Field parsing and scripts scale units through the same set.

facts.definition: A dimension with its linear units, each with a symbol, aliases, a scale to SI and whether it accepts SI prefixes. Field parsing and scripts scale units through the same set.

title: Unit state
summary: Whether a symbol unit of an instance is placed (has an occurrence), deliberately unused or unplaced. Placed and unused exclude each other; unused never implies a no-connect decision.

facts.definition: Whether a symbol unit of an instance is placed (has an occurrence), deliberately unused or unplaced. Placed and unused exclude each other; unused never implies a no-connect decision.

title: Value code
summary: A marking item that encodes a field value with a cited scheme (3- or 4-digit resistor code, EIA-96, capacitor pF code, tantalum voltage letter, IEC 60062 colour bands); a value the scheme cannot hold exactly gives no code, never a rounded one.

facts.definition: A marking item that encodes a field value with a cited scheme (3- or 4-digit resistor code, EIA-96, capacitor pF code, tantalum voltage letter, IEC 60062 colour bands); a value the scheme cannot hold exactly gives no code, never a rounded one.

title: Value template
summary: What a placed part shows as its value on the schematic, in the BOM and in the placement file: alternatives of text with `{Field}` placeholders over the fields its component selects, the first whose fields all have a value winning (`{Capacitance} {Rated voltage}`, then `{Capacitance}`). A generic family's parts take theirs from the family's data; stored by field lineage.

facts.definition: What a placed part shows as its value on the schematic, in the BOM and in the placement file: alternatives of text with `{Field}` placeholders over the fields its component selects, the first whose fields all have a value winning (`{Capacitance} {Rated voltage}`, then `{Capacitance}`). A generic family's parts take theirs from the family's data; stored by field lineage.

title: Walkaround
summary: The routing mode in which the route head goes round other nets' copper, keepouts and cutouts at the rule clearance, hugging them in its posture, and stops at the last legal point when no way round exists. Shove falls back to it.

facts.definition: The routing mode in which the route head goes round other nets' copper, keepouts and cutouts at the rule clearance, hugging them in its posture, and stops at the last legal point when no way round exists. Shove falls back to it.
